title: AEO startup Profound hits unicorn valuation, raises $180M Series D 7 months after last round
slides: Profound just hit unicorn status — but can AEO survive?
It raised $180M Series D in just 7 months
The startup tracks how AI chatbots mention brands
Brands ignoring AI search visibility risk losing customers
Test one AI answer about your brand today
thread_text:
1. The Unicorn Nobody Saw Coming

Profound just hit a $1B valuation after raising $180M in just 7 months. The speed is wild, but the real story is what they actually track.

2. Why Investors Are Obsessed

They monitor how AI chatbots mention brands. Not SEO, not ads — the new discovery layer where your customers are already asking questions.

3. The Silent Traffic Killer

If ChatGPT recommends your competitor and never mentions you, you lose the sale before you even know the conversation happened.

4. The AEO Survival Question

Profound's unicorn status proves AI search visibility is now a boardroom issue. But can they keep up as chatbots change weekly?

5. Test Your AI Visibility Now

Open ChatGPT and ask it to recommend a product in your category. If your brand doesn't show up, that's your new marketing emergency.
